name: Charles Bridge
description: Walk the stone span early, when the river is bright and the towers are still waking up.

name: Old Town Square
description: Take in the shifting façades, then slip into one of the smaller streets just beyond the square.

name: Prague Castle
description: The castle complex rewards an unhurried wander, especially as the evening light settles over the city.

name: Lennon Wall
description: A changing wall of colour and messages in a quiet corner of Malá Strana.
